informational.text: The `ds-time-picker` hour and minute columns that hold more values than they show run on past either end: after the last value the first comes round again, the selected value is scrolled to the middle of its column, and the column shows no scrollbar. `loop="never"`, or `DsConfig.timePicker.loop: 'never'`, keeps them as lists.
informational.verify: Open a ds-time-picker, scroll the hour column past its last hour and confirm the first hour follows, then reopen it and confirm the selected hour sits in the middle of the column.
